_comment: Item catalogue (v2, 2026-10-07 accelerated plan). Loaded by scripts/item_db.gd. Fields: name, type (behaviour: seed/crop/forage/resource/food/tool/weapon/ammo/medicine/placeable/artisan/equipment/quest), category (UI grouping), value (sell price in Credits, what the shipping box pays), buy_price (store price, only where something sells it), stack_max, icon, description. Type-specific: seed.crop_id; food.energy_restored (+hp_restored, stay_awake); medicine.hp_restored/rad_removed; tool.tool_kind; weapon.weapon_class/damage/cooldown/knockback/reach/ammo_item; equipment.slot/armor/rad_resist; placeable.places. Legacy entries (legacy:true) are kept only so old saves load. durability_max on farming tools is no longer enforced (tools never break - 2026-10-07 design call).

hoe.name: Hoe
hoe.description: Turns hard ground into farmland. Dad's old grip tape is still on it.

watering_can.name: Watering Can
watering_can.description: A patched can. Waters crops so they grow overnight. Refill it at any water.

axe.name: Axe
axe.description: Chops trees, branches and stumps into wood.

pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
pickaxe.description: Breaks rocks and pries apart scrap heaps.

scythe.name: Scythe
scythe.description: Clears weeds and tall grass in a wide arc. Weeds give fiber.

bag.name: Scavenger's Bag
bag.description: An old canvas bag. Mostly sentimental now.

seed_rain_radish.name: Rain Radish Seeds
seed_rain_radish.description: Spring. Ready in 4 days. The fastest crop there is.

seed_mutant_potato.name: Mutant Potato Seeds
seed_mutant_potato.description: Spring. Ready in 6 days. Sometimes yields extra.

seed_ironroot.name: Ironroot Seeds
seed_ironroot.description: Spring. Ready in 10 days. Slow, stubborn, valuable.

seed_bloodberry.name: Bloodberry Seeds
seed_bloodberry.description: Spring. Ready in 8 days, then fruits every 4.

seed_scorch_pepper.name: Scorch Pepper Seeds
seed_scorch_pepper.description: Summer. Ready in 5 days, then fruits every 3.

seed_blister_tomato.name: Blister Tomato Seeds
seed_blister_tomato.description: Summer. Ready in 9 days, then fruits every 4.

seed_dust_corn.name: Dust Corn Seeds
seed_dust_corn.description: Summer and autumn. Ready in 14 days, then every 4.

seed_sunbloom.name: Sunbloom Seeds
seed_sunbloom.description: Summer. Ready in 8 days. Turns to follow the sun, even at night.

seed_glow_melon.name: Glow Melon Seeds
seed_glow_melon.description: Summer. Ready in 12 days. Reads by its own light.

seed_dustwheat.name: Dustwheat Seeds
seed_dustwheat.description: Summer and autumn. Ready in 4 days.

seed_ember_pumpkin.name: Ember Pumpkin Seeds
seed_ember_pumpkin.description: Autumn. Ready in 13 days. Warm to the touch.

seed_rustvine_grape.name: Rustvine Grape Seeds
seed_rustvine_grape.description: Autumn. Ready in 10 days, then every 3.

seed_frostroot.name: Frostroot Seeds
seed_frostroot.description: Winter. Ready in 7 days. The only thing that grows out here in the cold.

seed_mixed.name: Wild Seeds
seed_mixed.description: A pinch of whatever blew in. Grows something in season.

rain_radish.name: Rain Radish
rain_radish.description: Crisp and peppery. Tastes like the first wet week of spring.

mutant_potato.name: Mutant Potato
mutant_potato.description: Lumpy, purple and absolutely fine to eat. Probably.

cleanleaf_kale.name: Cleanleaf Kale
cleanleaf_kale.description: Grown from a pre-war seed line. Suspiciously healthy.

ironroot.name: Ironroot
ironroot.description: A dense, rust-red root. Boils down into a hearty, metallic broth.

bloodberry.name: Bloodberry
bloodberry.description: Deep red and sweet. The name was a kid's joke that stuck.

scorch_pepper.name: Scorch Pepper
scorch_pepper.description: Hot enough to make a raider cry. Allegedly has.

sunbloom.name: Sunbloom
sunbloom.description: A huge golden flower. Settlers pay well to have one on the table.

glow_melon.name: Glow Melon
glow_melon.description: Faintly luminous and wonderfully sweet. Do not eat in the dark if you want to sleep.

dustwheat_grain.name: Dustwheat
dustwheat_grain.description: Hardy grain. Flour, feed or brewing.

ash_beet.name: Ash Beet
ash_beet.description: Grey on the outside, deep violet within.

ember_pumpkin.name: Ember Pumpkin
ember_pumpkin.description: Stays warm for days after picking. Nobody knows why. Nobody complains.

frostroot.name: Frostroot
frostroot.description: Pale blue and crunchy. Grows best when everything else gives up.

rad_morel.name: Rad Morel
rad_morel.description: Spring forage. A wrinkled mushroom that loves old ash.

dustdelion.name: Dustdelion
dustdelion.description: Spring forage. Make a wish; the wind does the rest.

sun_berries.name: Sun Berries
sun_berries.description: Summer forage. Little golden berries from the scrub.

sweet_reed.name: Sweet Reed
sweet_reed.description: Summer forage. Chewable, and the pith makes a decent sweetener.

ash_apple.name: Ash Apple
ash_apple.description: Autumn forage. From the old orchard trees nobody planted.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.description: Autumn forage. A softly glowing mushroom. Prized by Doc for medicine.

wasteland_walnut.name: Wasteland Walnut
wasteland_walnut.description: Autumn forage. Hard shell, rich meat.

snow_yam.name: Snow Yam
snow_yam.description: Winter forage. Dig where the frost cracks oddly.

crystal_moss.name: Crystal Moss
crystal_moss.description: Winter forage. Brittle, glittering moss that only grows in the cold.

frost_lichen.name: Frost Lichen
frost_lichen.description: Winter forage. Scraped from north-facing stones.

wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Split timber. The settlement runs on it.

hardwood.name: Hardwood
hardwood.description: Dense, old-growth timber from big stumps and fallen logs.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Rock. Good for walls, paths and throwing.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.description: Twisted pre-war metal. Smelt it into something useful.

fiber.name: Fiber
fiber.description: Tough plant fiber from weeds. Rope, cloth, compost.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.description: Fuel for the smelter. Made from wood in a kiln.

metal_bar.name: Metal Bar
metal_bar.description: Scrap, smelted and poured clean. The backbone of every upgrade.

copper_wire.name: Copper Wire
copper_wire.description: Stripped from old walls. Electricity's favourite road.

circuit_board.name: Circuit Board
circuit_board.description: Pre-war electronics. Still smarter than most of us.

battery.name: Battery
battery.description: Holds a charge. Precious beyond words.

plastic.name: Plastic
plastic.description: The old world's most durable legacy.

rubber.name: Rubber
rubber.description: Cut from old tires. Seals, straps, soles.

bottle_caps.name: Bottle Caps
bottle_caps.description: Not money. Tell that to the raiders.

tree_sap.name: Tree Sap
tree_sap.description: Sticky. Good for glue and fertiliser.

chemicals.name: Chemicals
chemicals.description: Unlabelled pre-war reagents. Doc knows what to do with them.

rad_crystal.name: Rad Crystal
rad_crystal.description: A green crystal that grows in hot zones. Handle with gloves. Sells for a fortune.

brass_casing.name: Brass Casing
brass_casing.description: Ammo component. Pick them up; they're worth more than you think.

lead_scrap.name: Lead Scrap
lead_scrap.description: Ammo component. Soft, heavy, melts easily.

bio_sample.name: Bio Sample
bio_sample.description: Taken from the infected. Doc wants these for research.

fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
fertilizer.description: Spread on tilled soil before planting for better crops.

quality_fertilizer.name: Rich Fertilizer
quality_fertilizer.description: Compost, sap and a secret. Much better crops.

cooked_meal.name: Wasteland Stew
cooked_meal.description: Whatever was in the pot. Delicious.

coffee.name: Scav-Brew Coffee
coffee.description: Real beans, somehow. Lets you stay up past 2 AM - once.

potato_hash.name: Potato Hash
potato_hash.description: Fried potatoes and peppers. Farmer's breakfast.

pepper_chili.name: Pepper Chili
pepper_chili.description: Warms you from the inside out. Then keeps going.

pumpkin_soup.name: Pumpkin Soup
pumpkin_soup.description: Smooth, golden, and still faintly glowing.

purified_water.name: Purified Water
purified_water.description: Clean water in a reused bottle. Worth more than gold out there.

choco_bar.name: Pre-War Choco Bar
choco_bar.description: Fifty years old and somehow still perfect. Science is terrifying.

milk.name: Cleanline Milk
milk.description: From a clean pre-war line. Rich and creamy.

mutant_goat_milk.name: Glow Goat Milk
mutant_goat_milk.description: Slightly fizzy. The goat seems proud of it.

mutant_egg.name: Two-Headed Egg
mutant_egg.description: Two yolks. Always. Every single time.

berry_jam.name: Berry Jam
berry_jam.description: Bloodberries, slow-cooked in a preserves jar.

cheese.name: Cheese
cheese.description: Aged in a cool cellar. Settlers fight over it.

rotgut.name: Rotgut
rotgut.description: Distilled from grain. Strips paint and inhibitions.

glow_wine.name: Glow Wine
glow_wine.description: Fermented glow melon. Faintly luminous in the bottle. Caravans pay a fortune.

honey.name: Wasteland Honey
honey.description: From very large, very polite bees.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: Restores 25 HP. Boiled cloth and good intentions.

adrenal_shot.name: Adrenal Shot
adrenal_shot.description: A jolt of pre-war chemistry. Faster legs, fresher arms, for a while.

rusty_pipe.name: Rusty Pipe
rusty_pipe.description: Melee. Heavy enough. Every scavenger's first friend.

machete.name: Machete
machete.description: Melee. Clears brush and problems alike.

rebar_club.name: Rebar Club
rebar_club.description: Melee. Concrete still attached. Sends things flying.

spiked_bat.name: Spiked Bat
spiked_bat.description: Melee. A classic for a reason.

officers_saber.name: Officer's Saber
officers_saber.description: Melee. A pre-war dress sword, wickedly sharp. Found where it shouldn't have been.

slingshot.name: Slingshot
slingshot.description: Ranged. Fires stones. Free ammo, modest results.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.description: Ranged. Silent, strong, slow. Bolts can be picked back up.

pipe_pistol.name: Pipe Pistol
pipe_pistol.description: Ranged. Homemade and loud. Every shot costs you.

hunting_rifle.name: Hunting Rifle
hunting_rifle.description: Ranged. One shot, one problem solved.

shotgun_shells.name: Shotgun Shells
shotgun_shells.description: Red paper shells packed with scrap shot.

crossbow_bolt.name: Crossbow Bolt
crossbow_bolt.description: Rebar-tipped. Reusable if you can find it.

scrap_vest.name: Scrap Vest
scrap_vest.description: Body. Road signs bolted to a jacket. Blocks 4 damage per hit.

rad_suit.name: Rad Suit
rad_suit.description: Body. A real pre-war suit. Cuts radiation exposure by 60%.

runner_boots.name: Runner Boots
runner_boots.description: Feet. Light soles, quick feet. +12% move speed.

scrap_sprinkler.name: Scrap Sprinkler
scrap_sprinkler.description: Waters the 4 tiles beside it every morning.

quality_sprinkler.name: Pressure Sprinkler
quality_sprinkler.description: Waters the 8 tiles around it every morning.

prewar_sprinkler.name: Pre-War Sprinkler
prewar_sprinkler.description: Waters 24 tiles around it every morning. They built things to last.

oil_lamp.name: Oil Lamp
oil_lamp.description: A warm pool of light for long nights.

compost_bin.name: Compost Bin
compost_bin.description: Turns fiber and spoiled crops into fertilizer.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.description: Melts scrap metal into clean metal bars. Burns charcoal.

recycler.name: Recycler
recycler.description: Breaks junk down into useful parts.

preserves_jar.name: Preserves Jar
preserves_jar.description: Turns fruit into jam and vegetables into pickles.

still.name: Copper Still
still.description: Grain becomes rotgut; glow melon becomes glow wine. Slowly.

bee_box.name: Bee Box
bee_box.description: Home for the big polite bees. Makes honey.

rad_rod.name: Storm Rod
rad_rod.description: Catches lightning during storms and turns it into batteries.

gravel_path.name: Gravel Path
gravel_path.description: Lay it down to make a path. Weeds won't grow on it.

cobble_path.name: Cobble Path
cobble_path.description: A proper path, like the old days.

scrap_gnome.name: Scrap Gnome
scrap_gnome.description: Pure decoration. He watches the crops. He judges.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.description: Pre-war plans. Read it to learn a new recipe.

lore_note.name: Old Note
lore_note.description: A scrap of someone's last days. Read it.

keycard.name: Keycard
keycard.description: Opens a sealed door somewhere in the city.

radio_part.name: Radio Part
radio_part.description: Harlan needs these to bring the old radio tower back.

prewar_relic.name: Pre-War Relic
prewar_relic.description: A strange little object from before. Collectors pay well.
